title: Mars destroyed by a CME and plasma events, Valles Marineris

tellings.quote: then weakens and I believe that is what caused the entire destruction of Mars

plain: The claim is that Mars was wrecked by a huge burst of charged gas thrown off by the sun, called a coronal mass ejection, along with electrical plasma events, and that these are tied to Valles Marineris, the planet's giant canyon system. A researcher named Matt LaCroix puts this forward as his own view, without naming a source: once something "then weakens," he says, "I believe that is what caused the entire destruction of Mars." If he is right, a planet could be stripped by the sun in a single disaster.
